title: Fifty turns down the stack and into the kernel
topic: HTTP, TLS, TCP, IP, the link layer, the operating system, and debugging
note: Fifty questions in one session. This set exists to answer a question a short run cannot: does the register hold, or does it decay as the session runs on? An eight-turn run showed the rate rising, with a scatter wider than the rise, so it could not separate a trend from noise. The set is pinned, so a later run changes only the prose.
provenance: Written by an agent that never read the standard, and never read the other question set. A rule forbade it from naming writing, style or clarity, because a question that asks for plain prose prompts the register this eval measures. Checked after the fact: no question names any of those words.
